dataList.content:
The war was over.
战争结束了。

Yet my doppelgänger still held that silly pose, that confident expression.
可我依然一脸自信地保持着滑稽的姿势。

Hmm, that’s not the kind of face I’d make.
呵，我可没摆过那副表情。

Though... gotta give it to ‘em for making the hair on my arm look as grotesque as it really is. Who drew this?
不过……我节肢上的毛倒是画得栩栩如生到让人恶心的地步。这是谁画的呢？

I’ve grown fond of humor.
看来我变幽默了呢。

Long years of drifting in the nightmare must've made me yearn for any hint of liveliness.
想来是被这梦魇困扰太久了，太渴望能好好活着了吧。

dataList.title:
Reminisced Person
回忆中的某人
dataList.content:
G Corp. scum should sent to the gallows. The whole lot of 'em.
那些G公司的渣滓们真该通通被斩首。

Someone murmurs, spitting on the floor.
我听到有谁一边嘟囔着，一边往地上啐了口痰的声音。

I didn't have to look at them to know who or what they were talking about.
不用看也知道他们说的是谁。

Knowing that...
或许是因为如此吧。

Hrk...
呕……

I felt nauseous.
我感到恶心。

dataList.title:
Reminisced Person
回忆中的某人
dataList.content:
Sir, are you alright?
先生，您还好吗？

Hey, something wrong? You look pale.
欸，你还好吗？你看起来脸色很差哦？
dataList.place:
Central Front in the Smoke War
烟霾战争 中部战线

dataList.content:
I was... just on the subway?
我刚刚是在……地铁上啊？

The hell are you blathering about?
你在胡扯什么呢？

Greg, we’re still on the battlefield.
格雷格，这里仍然是战场。

Gregor rummaged around in his pockets for a cigarette out of habit, then froze in place.
格里高尔颤抖着手习惯性地像是为了找香烟似的摸索着口袋，但很快就停下了。

It must've dawned on him as it did on me.
不管是他，还是我。

The rest of the Sinners seemed to have understood what was happening.
看起来所有罪人也都意识到了。

<Tomah is going to grab us and give a warning any second now...>
<接下来应该是轮到托玛以急切的语调劝告我们……>

dataList.title:
Reminisced Soldier
记忆中的士兵
dataList.content:
Are you—
你们是……

Look, Tomah, I’m starting to get a little sick of your line reading, so I’ll say it once: We’re not out of our minds, and the aging bomb ain’t gonna hit us.
托玛先生，我已经开始厌倦这些台词了，但是我们既没有疯，也不打算挨到老化炸弹。

dataList.title:
Reminisced Soldier
记忆中的士兵

dataList.content:
Instead of elaborating, he points up.
他默默地将手指举起指向上方。

dataList.title:
Reminisced Soldier
记忆中的士兵
dataList.content:
I need help.
救救我。

dataList.title:
Reminisced Soldier
记忆中的士兵
dataList.content:
I don’t want to die—
我不想死。

Tomah was crushed to a pulp right before our eyes.
在我们眼前被压爆的托玛没有留下丝毫的痕迹。

There’s only one thing to say in a situation like this.
这种时候，能说的只有一句话。

<R-run!>
<跑，快跑！>

All troops! Retreat!
全员！后退！

We muster up everything we can to run, but the airborne hand is ever persistent and shows no sign of letting up.
我们拼了命地奔跑，但从天而降的那只大手却紧追不舍，丝毫没有放弃的意思。

We’re all going to get turned into pancakes! Got any bright ideas, smartarse?
我们会被压成肉饼的！快想点办法，天才小姐？

... I’m listening. There are too many variables to consider in the fathoms of the ego, I can’t be hasty with my judgement...
……我在听。但是心象中的变数太多，所以很难快速做出决定……

There is no cause for hesitation! A true hero succumbs not to tribulation!
没什么可犹豫的！真正的英雄不会向任何苦难屈服！

Uhm... I don’t think I wanna recover a flattened body.
呃……我可不想搬运被压成薄片的尸体。

Oh! Sorry, Dante~ Didn’t mean it that way!
啊！抱歉，但丁~我没有那个意思！

I was tempted to snap back at her...
本来还想把罗佳的话怼回去的……

But keeping my mouth shut so the group could focus on making a run for it seemed like the sensible thing to do.
但我觉得闭上嘴，让大家集中精力奔跑才是上策。

Still thinking, are you? Eh?! Well, are you, Miss “Knows-it-all”?!
还没想好吗？啊？！“无所不知”的那位？

If it is an immediate solution you seek, then I have not obtained it yet.
如果只是眼下的解决办法的话，是的。我确实想到了一个对策。

The only thing that can be said for certain is that our objective is not nearby. Dante would have responded strongly otherwise.
可以确定的是这附近并没有金枝。因为如果有的话但丁经理应该会有更强烈一点的反应。

Are you joking? That’s all you’ve got?
你在开玩笑吗？现在为止你就分析出了这点东西吗？

Heathcliff furrowed his brows, ready to snap at the unhelpful savant...
希斯克利夫皱着眉，似乎还想说些什么……

But after a sudden close shave with the massive palm, he began speeding up without a word.
但看到以毫厘之差掠过的巨大手掌，他只好加快速度，把话憋了回去。

dataList.title:
Grade 8 Fixer
8阶收尾人
dataList.content:
... Gregor?
……格里高尔先生？

Whoa, hey, what? Why the hold up?
搞什么？为什么突然停下来了？

... I think I see now.
……我好像明白了。

If this world is a product of my mind...
如果这里是我的世界的话……

Gregor took a breather, then looked up at the sky.
喘了一会儿气的格里高尔望向了天空。

We shouldn’t run away from that hand.
那我们就不应该逃避那只手。

... Did you finally get the crackers or what?
……你终于还是疯了吗？

Gregor, are you sure?
格里高尔，你确定吗？

My life has never been mine to live.
我从来没有依我自己的意志活过……

It only makes sense that resisting is meaningless in this reflection of my mind.
所以这里，应该也是个反抗本身就毫无意义的空间。

In that case... letting the inevitable happen might be the answer.
那么……停止抵抗或许才是答案。

... Are you all serious?
……你们，都认真的？

It’s not like there’s any other way. We’re all exhausted.
不是没有别的方法了吗。我们已经精疲力竭了。

Besides... Look at the... patterns on its nails.
另外……瞧瞧那……手指甲。

You don’t see that kind of polish just anywhere.
那种花纹的指甲油可并不常见。

If that hand belongs to who I think it does, she will not stop chasing us.
如果这只手是属于我想的“那个人”的话，她应该不会再追我们了。

Faust... You said this is a path in my heart, right?
浮士德小姐……你说这就是我的心路，对吗？

Then I can tell you this for sure:
那样就可以确定了。

It’s about to hit a dead end.
我的心路，从这里开始就快到死胡同了。

Be it the nightmare or the road... I never once strayed from that woman’s control.
无论是噩梦，还是道路……我从未逃离那个人的掌控。

Who is Gregor talking about, and what does he mean by a nightmare?
那个人是谁，噩梦又是在说什么？

As much as I wanted to ask him...
虽然想问问格里高尔……

*sigh* Might as well.
唉，那就这样吧。

Soon enough, the giant hand cast its shadow over us, descending.
没过多久，地面上就出现了巨大的影子，

Just before it reached us, it stopped to hold us in its grasp.
就在快要砸下来之前，就将我们抓了起来。

Everything went dark.
眼前陷入一片漆黑，

I felt a disorienting nausea of being lifted into the sky.
感觉被举到了空中，我头晕目眩。

Mgrrh...
唔呃呃……

Only Faust and I managed to find our footing while everyone else stumbled around from the vertigo.
大家都在晕头转向的时候，只有我和浮士德直直地站在地上。

We found ourselves in another battlefield, albeit one that was more familiar to us.
我能感受到眼前的战场变成了熟悉的地方。
